environment.compression: Python standard-library compression.zstd; codec defines settings

method.cache: guards hash every representation before operations; OS file cache likely warm, never disk-cold. Hot TIFF handles retain GDAL block cache; custom has no decoded-chunk cache
method.cohort: 17 real plots on same full604x1233 AOI; controls selected on this seen AOI
method.confidence: one seen AOI, small timing sample, uncontrolled host scheduling; no population confidence interval
method.independent_masks: real masks all valid checked; nontrivial masks use independently packed3-band zstd stream loaded at initialization
method.indexed_granularity: custom additionally checks selected chunk hashes per read; TIFF readers rely on whole-file verification at initialization and GDAL decoding
method.integrity: all stored raster/payload files hashed during initialization; expected metadata-file SHA checked for every path
method.p95: nearest rank; seven samples gives maximum
method.preprocessing: one encode per candidate in isolated child, source load excluded; custom reproduced byte-identically in owned scratch without changing accepted store
method.process_cold: new child per sample; load/hash-validation+17 queries timed; startup inclusive separately
method.query: original global center lattice for full and indexed queries; no shifted-window reselection
method.resources: isolated child lifetime RSS includes imports/inputs; native platform units retained
method.scope: ms per17-query batch; full loads and initialized indexed readers measured separately
